overview_description.description:
Okta is the provider of identity for the enterprise. The Okta Identity Cloud connects and protects employees of many enterprises. It also securely connects enterprises to their partners, suppliers, and customers. With deep integrations to over 5,000 apps, the Okta Identity Cloud enables simple and secure access from any device.

Okta helps customers fulfill their missions faster by making it safe and easy to use the technologies they need to do their significant work.

about_short_description.short_description: Okta is a management platform that secures critical resources from cloud to ground for workforce and customers.

product.name: Okta Platform
product.description: A cloud-based identity platform for securing workforce, partner, customer, and non-human access to applications, systems, APIs, and devices.

product.name: Auth0 Platform
product.description: A developer-oriented customer identity platform for adding authentication, authorization, user management, and identity workflows to web, mobile, and API-based applications.

product.name: Okta Workforce Identity
product.description: A workforce identity solution that manages employee access to applications, devices, infrastructure, and APIs through centralized authentication, authorization, and identity controls.

product.name: Okta Customer Identity
product.description: A customer identity and access management solution for managing external users, authentication, authorization, registration, and account security across digital applications and services.

product.name: Okta for AI Agents
product.description: An identity governance and security offering for managing AI agent identities, access, permissions, and lifecycle activity across connected applications and tools.

product.name: Okta Identity Governance
product.description: An identity governance solution for managing access requests, approvals, certifications, policy enforcement, and identity lifecycle controls.
